name: finazza
description: FINAZZA investment social network — web MVP

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @finazza/api" "npm run dev -w @finazza/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @finazza/api && npm run typecheck -w @finazza/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @finazza/api && npm run build -w @finazza/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run start -w @finazza/api" "npm run start -w @finazza/web"
